Normally, for a GOI skip, I'd recommend a crosslink to the groups hub. However, Alexylva is one of the few remaining groups of interest without one. Luckily, a tale hub called Parable of the Wayward Prince acts very much as the same thing, linking numerous skips and tales for this group together. An inline link to this hub would allow for a large amount of wikiwalking to take place for any such reader interested. As such, I am proposing the following edits:

Changing this:

SCP-877 is a set of four ten twelve microchips acquired between 199█ and 201█ from the cerebral cortices of different small mammals. Animals found to contain copies of SCP-877 include, but are not limited to, Sciurus carolinensis (the eastern gray squirrel), Felis catus (the domestic cat), and Eumops perotis (the western mastiff bat). The microchips are unmarked except for small stamps, readable only by electron microscope, that read “ALEXYLVA UNIVERSITY BIOLOGY DEPT,” followed by “GENERATION” and a number. However, no records exist of an institution named “Alexylva University.” Moreover, the abilities of these microchips are beyond the technological capability of any known laboratory to create.

To this:

SCP-877 is a set of four ten twelve microchips acquired between 199█ and 201█ from the cerebral cortices of different small mammals. Animals found to contain copies of SCP-877 include, but are not limited to, Sciurus carolinensis (the eastern gray squirrel), Felis catus (the domestic cat), and Eumops perotis (the western mastiff bat). The microchips are unmarked except for small stamps, readable only by electron microscope, that read “ALEXYLVA UNIVERSITY BIOLOGY DEPT,” followed by “GENERATION” and a number. However, no records exist of an institution named “Alexylva University.” Moreover, the abilities of these microchips are beyond the technological capability of any known laboratory to create.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Really creepy, in a sneaks-up-on-you kind of way.

I do think that the crossing to a reptile should be remarked upon in the logs - come on, it's the first time this thing has appeared in a non-mammal - and I find it very hard to believe that the child attacked by the animals would not already be in Foundation custody before exhibiting aggressive behaviour. I mean, mammals is mammals, right?

Still, a really good example of an understated SCP, talking about something that could take control of the entire human race within weeks in such a calm and logical way.

Upvoted. :)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Wikipedia doesn't mention silicon being in bones, though I have found mentions of studies showing that dietary silicon can lead to healthier bones. Also according to Wikipedia, a 70 kg adult human will about about 1 gram of silicon in their body. However, I haven't been able to find any references to the biology behind living things using silicon, asides from plants and diatoms.

Maybe it could be made from a carbon-based semi-conductor that's only shown to not be silicon-based when chemical analysis is done.
